guard: a managed connector seat preserves its credential file as a standing-renewal source and reconnects on a same-identity re-sign after the boot credential expires
why: The mutation restores the reported production defect at the exact connector config seam: it passes the first file contents as a static string instead of a function that re-reads the path.

The suite crosses the first JWT expiry on a real isolated auth broker, then invokes the real cotal_reconnect tool. Its named failure must say that the endpoint holds no creds source, not merely report an unrelated red.
The build is part of every run because the connector package resolves @cotal-ai/core through dist. afterRestore rebuilds so the ignored dist tree cannot retain the mutant after source restoration.

mutations.name: managed connector credentials revert to the one-time boot read
mutations.expectRed: holds no creds source to renew them
mutations.cell: cotal_reconnect adopts the renewed file and reports connected after the old JWT expiry
mutations.note: This is the source-level shape from issue #1189. The first identity read remains, so the mutation isolates source adoption rather than breaking config parsing or card identity.
